learning_outcomes.text: Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize
Demonstrate skills for organization, planning, and strategy
Acquire the ability to effectively solve problems
Express oneself correctly in Spanish, both orally and in writing
Acquire skills related to the use of computer programs for calculation, data analysis, and processing within their field of application.
Ability to apply knowledge to practice
Acquire the capacity for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement

Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge of: linear algebra; geometry; differential geometry; differential and integral calculus; differential and partial differential equations; numerical methods; numerical algorithms; statistics and optimization.

syllabus_topics: Scalar and vector functions of several real variables
Extrema of a real function of several variables
Fubini's theorem and change of variable
Basic definitions of curves and surfaces
Integration over curves. Conservative fields. Green's theorem
Integration over surfaces. Stokes' theorem. Gauss's theorem. Applications
teaching_methods: Completion of assignments, reports, memoirs, and evaluation tests

assessment_methods.method: Written test of theory and problems on the first part of the course
Written test of theory and problems on the second part of the course
Resolution of exercises and questions in the computer lab

assessment_rules: To pass the subject, the weighted average of the grades of the mentioned procedures must be greater than or equal to 5 (out of 10 points). It is essential to obtain 3.5 points (out of 10) in each of the first two evaluation procedures, and a minimum of 3 points (out of 10) in the third. If a student does not meet any of the mentioned minimums, the overall grade will be calculated according to the UBU Evaluation Regulations. Exceptional evaluation consists of a written test for the first part (40%), a written test for the second part (40%), and a practical exam in the computer lab (20%).
